changes.name: getDefaultChannel
changes.description: Guild#getDefaultChannel() returns a GuildChannel instead of a TextChannel, the default channel can be a voice or forum channel.
changes.migration: Check the returned GuildChannel with instanceof TextChannel before using it as a text channel.

changes.name: getReactors
changes.description: Reaction#getReactors() returns a List<User> instead of a List<Member>, members are returned by Reaction#getReactorMembers() (named getReactorMemberss() in 0.0.17, null in DMs).
changes.migration: Use getReactorMembers() for members (handle null in DMs), or work with the users returned by getReactors().

changes.description: ConsoleCommand stores its aliases as a List<String> instead of a String[].
changes.migration: Pass List.of(aliases) instead of the array.

changes.name: aliases
changes.description: ConsoleCommand#aliases() returns a List<String> instead of a String[].
changes.migration: Use the returned list, or convert it with aliases().toArray(String[]::new).

changes.name: INTEGER
changes.description: Integer command arguments deliver Long values instead of Integer values, because Discord integers are 53 bit.
changes.migration: Read NUMBER arguments as Long (or Number) instead of Integer.

changes.name: getExpiryTime
changes.description: Invite#getExpiryTime() returns null for invites, which never expire.

changes.name: asLong
changes.description: The values of SET_VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS, SEND_POLLS, USE_EXTERNAL_APPS, PIN_MESSAGES and BYPASS_SLOWMODE were wrong and now match Discord, permission numbers stored by older versions decode differently.
changes.migration: Store permissions by name (Permission#name()) instead of as a number, or convert stored numbers.

changes.name: fromLong
changes.description: The values of SET_VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS, SEND_POLLS, USE_EXTERNAL_APPS, PIN_MESSAGES and BYPASS_SLOWMODE were wrong and now match Discord, permission numbers stored by older versions decode differently.
changes.migration: Store permissions by name (Permission#name()) instead of as a number, or convert stored numbers.

changes.name: VOICE
changes.description: Voice channels are VoiceChannel instead of TextChannel, casting them to TextChannel fails.
changes.migration: Cast voice channels to VoiceChannel, which is a MessageChannel and GuildChannel as well.

changes.name: STAGE
changes.description: Stage channels are VoiceChannel instead of TextChannel, casting them to TextChannel fails.
changes.migration: Cast stage channels to VoiceChannel, which is a MessageChannel and GuildChannel as well.
